sources.entry: DevUtils.app - Developer Utilities for macOS, helps you with your tiny daily tasks with just a single click! i.e., JSON Formatter, UUID Generator...

summary.one_liner: DevUtils is a macOS app of developer utilities, such as a JSON formatter and UUID generator, for small everyday tasks.
summary.what_it_does: The README was not available, so this summary relies only on the listing text. The listing describes DevUtils.app as a set of developer utilities for macOS that run with a single click. It names a JSON formatter and a UUID generator as examples. Nothing else about its features, internals or supported versions could be confirmed.
notable: Includes a JSON formatter and UUID generator (per listing)
